sources.note: Main product page. Describes CloudCraft as 'all-in-one solution for electronic health records, practice management, billing, and human resources.' Very sparse on details — no feature pages, no module descriptions, no customer testimonials.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Repeats the same high-level product description as the main site. Links to certification criteria, CQMs, SED, G1/G2 measures, compliance activities, and real world testing but provides no additional product detail.

EHI export documentation page. Describes two export pathways (provider bulk export and patient FHIR-based export). Lists exportable data: C-CDA USCDI v3, PDFs, images (JPEG/GIF/TIF), Word documents, and internal correspondence (tasks, notes). Reveals the product stores scanned paper records and digital faxes.
NAIA Corporation main website (SSL certificate misconfigured for www subdomain — cert covers *.naiacorp.net only). Could not load directly.

BhamWiki article on NAIA Corporation. Founded 1997 by Terry Lee. IT services and consulting firm in Birmingham, Alabama. Offices in Hyderabad, India and Birmingham, England. Tanveer Patel hired as CEO in 2010. No mention of healthcare or EHR products.

ZoomInfo listing for NAIA Corporation. 11-50 employees, under $5M revenue. Birmingham, Alabama headquarters. Described as IT services/consulting since 1997. Blocked by login wall but search snippet confirmed company details.

CloudCraft FHIR R4 server homepage. Lists two organizations: 'CloudCraft Practice' (base/test) and 'Goshen Medical Center' — confirming Goshen as a customer. Server version R4-6.0.87. Exposes Endpoint and Organization FHIR resources.
CloudCraft patient portal. Angular-based web application. Requires JavaScript. No information extractable about features without authentication.
Sliding fee schedule module. Angular-based web app hosted on naiacorp.net. Suggests FQHC-oriented functionality for income-based discount management.

Goshen Medical Center patient information page. Links to NAIA's patient portal (ehrpatientportal.naiacorp.net), confirming Goshen Medical Center as a CloudCraft customer. Goshen is an FQHC with 38 locations in eastern North Carolina.

Capterra listing for 'Cloudcraft' — this is a DIFFERENT product (AWS cloud architecture diagramming tool by Datadog), NOT the healthcare EHR. No reviews found for CloudCraft Software (the EHR) on any major review platform.
Crunchbase listing for NAIA Corporation. Could not access full details (login required). Search snippet confirmed founding and basic company info.
RocketReach listing for Terry Lee, President & CEO of NAIA Corporation. Confirms leadership role.
